title: OnboardingActionEnvelope
description: Machine-readable result shared by the non-interactive Goobers onboarding actions.

action.description: Which onboarding action produced this envelope.

version.description: Envelope version, incremented when the payload shape changes.

created.description: Paths or logical assets installed by the action.

skipped.description: Paths or logical assets left untouched because they were already current or pending.

updated.description: Existing files or entries rewritten in place by the action.

path.description: Absolute path to the action's destination.

nextCommand.description: Ready-to-run command that checks or validates the action result.

prompts.description: Ready-to-use coding-agent prompts emitted by actions that install agent assistance.

commands.description: Ready-to-run maintenance commands emitted by actions that install managed assets.
